s.t: ‘Schmetterling’ was the B-side of Cari Cari's first ever vinyl single, with ‘Farfalla’: 280 butterfly-shaped, laser-cut copies on translucent purple ‘caterpillar wax’.
s.src: Cari Cari shop: Farfalla / Schmetterling single vinyl
s.q: On translucent purple caterpillar wax Limited to 280 pieces ! Butterfly-shaped laser cut vinyl The very first vinyl single in Cari Cari history!

s.t: Cari Cari paired it with ‘Farfalla’, Italian for butterfly, reflecting Stephanie Widmer's introspective side; ‘Schmetterling’ carries Alexander Köck's extroverted spirit and the raw energy of their live shows.
s.src: European Radio Plugging: Cari Cari – Farfalla/Schmetterling
s.q: “Farfalla,” which means butterfly in Italian, embodies the softer, more introspective side of Cari Cari’s music. ... “Schmetterling,” the German equivalent of butterfly, is its powerful counterpart. This track is infused with the raw energy and intensity that characterize Cari Cari’s live shows. Alexander Köck’s extroverted spirit shines through

s.t: In Cari Cari's video, a masked wrestler's flying leap from the ropes misses, sending him crashing through the floor into an underworld, where the band's singer swallows him mid-fall.
s.src: London Music Video Awards: Cari Cari – Schmetterling, Music Video of the Week
s.q: the wrestler climbs the ropes to deliver a finishing move. Time slows as he leaps, but his opponent rolls away, sending him crashing through the floor into a dark, underworld-like dreamscape. Here, the surreal takes centre stage. The song’s lead singer appears in this haunting realm, swallowing the wrestler mid-fall.

s.t: Cari Cari had just bought the gong on ‘Schmetterling’, and the radio station FM4 suspected it explained how deeply relaxed their album One More Trip Around the Sun sounds.
s.src: FM4: „One More Trip Around the Sun“ ist Cari Caris Album #3!
s.q: Es ist ein tiefenentspanntes Album! Schuld daran ist womöglich der frisch angeschaffte Gong - unter anderem in „One More Trip Around The Sun” und „Schmetterling“ zu hören.

f.t: They formed the band to get their music into a Quentin Tarantino film; in 2022 Stephanie Widmer said they still meant to, under pressure as he planned just one more.
f.src: A38 blog: Everybody should have their personal Kookoo Island | Cari Cari
f.q: you founded the band to get your music into a Tarantino movie (and you also made the song Dear Mr Tarantino). Are you still aiming for this? Stephanie: Yes we still do. He’ll make just one more movie, so there’s a lot of pressure on the matter right now (laughs).

f.t: Their drummer, Stephanie Widmer, sat down at a drum kit for the first time just two weeks before they recorded their debut EP.
f.src: Austrian Music Export: “We don’t have to ask anyone for permission” – an interview with Cari Cari
f.q: For example, two weeks before the recording session for our debut EP, Stephanie sat down in front of a drum set for the first time.

f.t: Alexander Köck booked Stephanie Widmer to support his first band, The Golden Rabbit, was blown away, recorded her in his parents' basement, then sneaked into her band.
f.src: A38 blog: Everybody should have their personal Kookoo Island | Cari Cari
f.q: We met at the gig of my first band The Golden Rabbit. I found Stephanie’s music online and asked her if she wanted to be our support band. I was so blown away by her performance that I asked if I could record her music in my home studio in my parents’ basement. She said yes and I somehow managed to sneak into her band (laughs).

f.t: After TV's Shameless used their music, they tried a professional studio, where a man wanted 20 microphones on the drums alone; finding it characterless, they scrapped the recording.
f.src: Austrian Music Export: “We don’t have to ask anyone for permission” – an interview with Cari Cari
f.q: From one day to the next we were being played in the American TV series “Shameless”, went on tour in Australia, worked on our second EP. Now all of a sudden a lot of people got involved and thought that it was time for a professional studio. We stood in front of a guy who wanted to record the drums alone with 20 microphones. It was all dead, characterless, and far too serious. We thought hard about it for a long time until we decided to completely dump this whole recording operation.

f.t: They flew straight from the Reeperbahn Festival to Egypt; the Reeperbahn paid ten times as much, but Alexander Köck says the Alexandria gig is the one he'll remember.
f.src: Gaesteliste.de: Cari Cari – Die neue Bodenständigkeit
f.q: Wir haben zum Beispiel einen Auftritt auf dem Reeperbahn Festival gespielt, wo es viel Industrie gibt und alles schon sehr gesättigt ist und sind gleich danach nach Ägypten geflogen, wo die Leute nach Kultur und Konzerten dürsten. Natürlich haben wir beim Reeperbahn Festival die zehnfache Gage bekommen – aber erinnern werde ich mich an das Konzert, das wir in Alexandria gespielt haben.

nf.t: It came out as a butterfly-shaped vinyl single, which sold out straight away
nf.src: FM4: Die FM4 Neuvorstellungen der Woche
nf.q: erschien „Farfalla/Butterfly“ auch gleich als schmetterlingsförmige (!) Vinylsingle, die natürlich sofort ausverkauft war.
